description: This file defines the IdentityManager class responsible for license validation, SSO provider initialization, and Stripe subscription management within the FlowiseAI project.

classes.name: IdentityManager
classes.description: Manages license validation, SSO providers, and Stripe subscriptions for FlowiseAI.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton method to get the instance of IdentityManager.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes license validation, permissions, and Stripe manager if applicable.

methods.name: getPlatformType
methods.description: Returns the current platform type (Open Source, Cloud, Enterprise).

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions object.

methods.name: isEnterprise
methods.description: Checks if current platform is Enterprise.

methods.name: isCloud
methods.description: Checks if current platform is Cloud.

methods.name: isOpenSource
methods.description: Checks if current platform is Open Source.

methods.name: isLicenseValid
methods.description: Returns whether the license is valid.

methods.name: _offlineVerifyLicense
methods.description: Verifies license key offline using public key.

methods.name: _validateLicenseKey
methods.description: Validates license key via environment variables and external URL.

methods.name: initializeSSO
methods.description: Initializes SSO providers based on platform and organization settings.

methods.name: initializeEmptySSO
methods.description: Initializes all SSO providers with undefined config.

methods.name: initializeSsoProvider
methods.description: Initializes a specific SSO provider with given config.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves refresh token from specified SSO provider.

methods.name: getProductIdFromSubscription
methods.description: Fetches product ID associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getFeaturesByPlan
methods.description: Returns feature flags based on subscription plan.

methods.name: checkFeatureByPlan
methods.description: Middleware to check if a feature is enabled for the user.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe customer portal session.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Gets additional seats quantity for a subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Retrieves customer info with default payment source.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration for additional seats.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates additional seats in a subscription and updates cache.

methods.name: getPlanProration
methods.description: Calculates proration for plan change.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates subscription plan and manages cache and user session.

methods.name: createStripeUserAndSubscribe
methods.description: Creates a Stripe customer and subscription based on user plan.
